html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,400;1,9..144,600&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter+Tight:wght@500;700;800&display=swap');
  /* An essay blog on a 74rem page: a quiet site bar, the masthead on a band with a texture under it, the editor's pick
     as a wide story (photo beside the copy), then the posts as cards with the archive beside them. Serif headlines
     (Fraunces) over a humanist sans (Figtree); one accent for links and the word that matters. Looks: Journal (ivory
     and forest green, follows light / dark), Night shift (ink blue and amber, a grain gradient behind the masthead)
     and Ink (paper white, black and vermilion, grotesque headlines over a halftone of dots). */
  #site-blog {
    --background: oklch(0.982 0.005 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.012 70);
    --card: oklch(0.995 0.003 85);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0.008 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.47 0.015 70);
    --border: oklch(0.22 0.012 70 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.22 0.012 70 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.42 0.075 165);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.005 85);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.008 85);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.025 165);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.06 165);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0.5rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --blog-head: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
    --blog-band: oklch(0.955 0.012 120);
    --blog-letter: oklch(0.27 0.04 165);
    --blog-letter-ink: oklch(0.97 0.01 120);
    color-scheme: light;
    container-type: inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.55 'Figtree',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  #site-blog > :not(dialog) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding-inline: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
  }
  #site-blog > :not(dialog) > :not(.shader, .surface) {
    max-width: 74rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  .dark #site-blog[data-look='journal'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.19 0.01 160);
    --foreground: oklch(0.94 0.008 85);
    --card: oklch(0.225 0.012 160);
    --muted: oklch(0.25 0.012 160);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.74 0.015 100);
    --border: oklch(0.94 0.008 85 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.94 0.008 85 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.78 0.09 165);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.19 0.01 160);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.012 160);
    --accent: oklch(0.3 0.04 165);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.88 0.06 165);
    --blog-band: oklch(0.22 0.014 160);
    --blog-letter: oklch(0.82 0.08 165);
    --blog-letter-ink: oklch(0.2 0.03 165);
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='night'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.18 0.022 255);
    --foreground: oklch(0.94 0.012 85);
    --card: oklch(0.215 0.025 255);
    --muted: oklch(0.25 0.028 255);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.02 250);
    --border: oklch(0.94 0.012 85 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.94 0.012 85 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.82 0.12 75);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.18 0.022 255);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.028 255);
    --accent: oklch(0.3 0.04 75);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.88 0.1 80);
    --blog-band: oklch(0.15 0.025 255);
    --blog-letter: oklch(0.82 0.12 75);
    --blog-letter-ink: oklch(0.18 0.022 255);
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.995 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.14 0 0);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.955 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.42 0 0);
    --border: oklch(0.14 0 0 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.14 0 0 / 0.3);
    --primary: oklch(0.58 0.2 32);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.995 0 0);
    --accent: oklch(0.95 0.03 32);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.17 32);
    --radius: 0rem;
    --blog-head: 'Inter Tight', var(--font-sans);
    --blog-band: oklch(0.955 0 0);
    --blog-letter: oklch(0.14 0 0);
    --blog-letter-ink: oklch(0.995 0 0);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='journal'] .blog-look-only[data-for='journal'],
  #site-blog[data-look='night'] .blog-look-only[data-for='night'],
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .blog-look-only[data-for='ink'] {
    display: block;
  }
  #site-blog [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* the site bar (Site Header): the name, the journal's links, then the look, the language, the mode and Subscribe */
  #site-blog .mk-header.blog-bar {
    background: transparent;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-bar-inner {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    min-height: 4.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-bar .mk-header-nav {
    margin-inline-end: auto;
  }
  /* narrow: the menu button sits at the end of the brand's row, the controls wrap below */
  #site-blog .blog-bar .site-menu {
    margin-inline-start: auto;
  }
  #site-blog .sheet .mk-header-sheet-actions {
    display: grid;
    justify-content: stretch;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-bar .nav-menu-list {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-bar .nav-menu-link {
    padding: 0.25rem 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font:
      600 0.9375rem/1.2 'Figtree',
      var(--font-sans);
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-bar .nav-menu-link:hover,
  #site-blog .blog-bar .nav-menu-link[aria-current] {
    background: none;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-brand {
    display: block;
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
    font: 600 1.375rem/1 var(--blog-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-brand i {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-bar-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    flex-shrink: 1;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-bar .select {
    min-width: 8.5rem;
  }
  /* the masthead band: a texture under the title, the categories as tabs along its foot */
  #site-blog .blog-band {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: clip;
    background: var(--blog-band);
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header {
    position: static;
    gap: 2.25rem;
    padding-block: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) 0;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-grain {
    --surface-size: 180px;
    --surface-ink: oklch(0.3 0.02 90 / 0.035);
    --surface-bg: transparent;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-dots {
    --surface-size: 14px;
    --surface-ink: oklch(0.14 0 0 / 0.08);
    --surface-bg: transparent;
    mask-image: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 35%, #000 85%);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-glow {
    opacity: 0.75;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-copy {
    gap: 1rem;
    max-width: 48rem;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-eyebrow {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-title {
    font: 600 clamp(2.5rem, 6.5vw, 4.75rem)/1.02 var(--blog-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .mk-blog-header-title {
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  }
  /* the word that matters: italic, in the accent */
  #site-blog .blog-marker {
    background: none;
    color: var(--primary);
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .blog-marker {
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-decoration: underline 0.09em;
    text-underline-offset: 0.1em;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-desc {
    max-width: 36rem;
    font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.6vw, 1.25rem);
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-categories {
    gap: 0 1.75rem;
    width: 100%;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-categories a {
    height: auto;
    padding: 1rem 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: none;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 transparent;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-categories a:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-header-categories a[aria-current] {
    background: none;
    color: var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary);
  }
  /* the posts and the archive */
  #site-blog .blog-main {
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-columns {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 3rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  @container (width > 62rem) {
    #site-blog .blog-columns {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 15rem;
      gap: 4rem;
    }
  }
  #site-blog .blog-stream {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-item-title {
    font-family: var(--blog-head);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .mk-blog-item-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-item-title a {
    color: inherit;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-item-meta {
    gap: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-item-meta .badge {
    height: auto;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-item-excerpt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-item-byline {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  #site-blog .mk-blog-item-media {
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  /* the editor's pick: the photo beside the copy, a label on the photo */
  #site-blog .blog-lead {
    position: relative;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-lead .mk-blog-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  @container (width > 46rem) {
    #site-blog .blog-lead .mk-blog-item {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2.5rem;
    }
  }
  #site-blog .blog-lead .mk-blog-item-media {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-lead .mk-blog-item-body {
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-lead .mk-blog-item-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 3.4vw, 2.75rem);
    line-height: 1.08;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-lead .mk-blog-item-excerpt {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-note {
    position: absolute;
    top: 1rem;
    left: 1rem;
    z-index: 1;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35);
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .blog-note {
    border-radius: 0;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  /* the cards: photo, label, title, excerpt, byline - a hairline above the grid */
  #site-blog .blog-posts {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2.75rem 2rem;
    padding-block-start: 2.75rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-posts .mk-blog-item-title {
    font-size: 1.3125rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-posts .mk-blog-item-media {
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-posts .mk-blog-item:hover .mk-blog-item-media {
    opacity: 0.88;
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .blog-posts .mk-blog-item-media img {
    filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.08);
  }
  /* the Sunday letter: the one solid block among the cards */
  #site-blog .blog-letter {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 2rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--blog-letter);
    color: var(--blog-letter-ink);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-letter h3 {
    margin: 0;
    font: 600 1.625rem/1.15 var(--blog-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-letter p {
    margin: 0;
    color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 78%, transparent);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-letter form {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-letter .input {
    flex: 1 1 10rem;
    border-color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 30%, transparent);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 8%, transparent);
    color: inherit;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-letter .input::placeholder {
    color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 60%, transparent);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-letter .btn {
    background: var(--blog-letter-ink);
    color: var(--blog-letter);
  }
  /* the archive: a quiet column */
  #site-blog .mk-archive-index-title {
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
    font:
      700 0.75rem/1.2 'Figtree',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-blog .mk-archive-index a[aria-current] {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    #site-blog .blog-posts .mk-blog-item-media {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
  #site-blog .blog-letter-done {
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  /* a post: the headline over a wide photo, the essay in one serif column, then the author and the way on */
  #site-blog .blog-post {
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem) clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post > * + * {
    margin-block-start: 2.5rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .blog-post-back {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: 42rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post-back a {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post-back a:hover {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post-back svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-header {
    max-width: none;
    padding: 0;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 1.125rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-header > :not(figure) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 42rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-header-category {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-header-title {
    font: 600 clamp(2.25rem, 5.5vw, 3.75rem)/1.05 var(--blog-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .blog-post .mk-article-header-title {
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-header-subtitle {
    font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.8vw, 1.3125rem);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-header-media {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 64rem;
    margin: 1rem auto 0;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-header-media img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 2 / 1;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .blog-post .mk-article-header-media img {
    filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.08);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-body {
    --_measure: 42rem;
    max-width: var(--_measure);
    padding: 0;
    font:
      400 clamp(1.0625rem, 1.5vw, 1.1875rem)/1.75 'Fraunces',
      Georgia,
      serif;
  }
  #site-blog[data-look='ink'] .blog-post .mk-article-body {
    font-family: 'Figtree', var(--font-sans);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-body > blockquote {
    margin: 2.25rem 0;
    padding: 0 0 0 1.5rem;
    border: 0;
    border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--primary);
    background: none;
    font-style: normal;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-body > blockquote p {
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 italic clamp(1.375rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem)/1.3 var(--blog-head);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-body > blockquote cite {
    display: block;
    margin-block-start: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font:
      600 0.875rem/1.3 'Figtree',
      sans-serif;
    font-style: normal;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .blog-post-after {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2.25rem;
    max-width: 42rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-author-bio {
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-author-bio-label {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-author-bio-name {
    font: 600 1.375rem/1.2 var(--blog-head);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-post .mk-article-nav-title {
    font: 600 1.0625rem/1.3 var(--blog-head);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-more {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding-block-start: 2.5rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-more h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font: 600 1.75rem/1.15 var(--blog-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-more .blog-posts {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  /* the dialogs: the Sunday letter and About */
  #site-blog .blog-dialog .dialog-title {
    font: 600 1.625rem/1.15 var(--blog-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-dialog .dialog-body {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-dialog .dialog-body p {
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.375rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-note-small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  /* the footer (Site Footer): the journal in a line, the way round it, the archive */
  #site-blog .mk-footer.blog-footer {
    background: var(--blog-band);
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-blog .blog-footer .mk-footer-inner {
    padding: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem) 0 2rem;
    gap: 2rem;
  }
  #site-blog .blog-footer .mk-footer-about p {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 22rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
